deepWestExtension.dataset: City of Austin Planimetrics 2023 - Building Footprints 2023 (layer 0)
deepWestExtension.use: footprint rings/holes and MAX_HEIGHT (US survey feet)

deepWestExtension.dataset: City of Austin Planimetrics 2023 - Impervious Cover 2023 (layer 1; roads, sidewalks, pavement, courtyards, alleys, trails)
USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) bare-earth DEM via the National Map elevation ImageServer
deepWestExtension.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work). Credit: U.S. Geological Survey.

limitations: 2023 footprints are not a current-building survey
facade materials, windows, parapets and pitched roofs are generic estimates
road polygons do not establish permissions or markings
no trees or bridges are modelled in the extension
